facts.claim: Koningsdam (Holland America Line): Entered service 2016; 99,840 GT; 2660 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 300 m length; Pinnacle class.
MS Koningsdam is a Pinnacle-class cruise ship operated by Holland America Line (HAL), a division of Carnival Corporation & plc.

Koningsdam is the lead vessel of HAL's Pinnacle class and the first to be named after the King of the Netherlands, her sister ships include Nieuw Statendam (2018) and Rotterdam (2021), all of which were built by Italian shipbuilder Fincantieri.
